inclusion_policy: Retain executable bridge/daemon code, scripts, upstream patches, tests, packaging metadata, README and license required to run, validate, and understand the tool.
exclusion_reason: Repository/agent instruction metadata and optional skill wrappers are not runtime dependencies of the Mesen bridge and would create a second agent-instruction surface inside UR-Recomp.
install_contract: tools/bootstrap_toolchain.py stages this source locally and tools/install_pure_python_tool.py installs the dependency-free src-layout package using only the Python standard library. No PyPI/build isolation is required.
